args.prompt:
One continuous 30-second take: a single unbroken camera move, no cuts, no jump cuts, no scene changes, no time skips. Smooth gimbal, no shake. 35mm film look, soft natural grain, shallow depth of field.
CAST: @Image1 shows the exact product: a heavy rectangular perfume bottle of thick clear glass filled with amber-gold perfume, a faceted smoky dark-amber glass cap, the word VESPER engraved once on the front face only. It is the only product and the only readable text. The bottle always faces the camera straight on; it never rotates, never moves, never changes shape, proportions or size; it keeps four flat sides and one single VESPER engraving on the front, sharp and unchanged.
FIRST FRAME: the bottle stands on a polished dark marble ledge high above a city skyline; the sun sits low on the horizon directly behind it, flooding the glass with orange light.
RULES: real physics; the camera NEVER orbits or circles: it only moves straight forward, very slowly, with a slight rise. The sky changes continuously like a slow time-lapse from sunset to blue hour to night, never a cut.
[0-8 s] The camera is already moving: a slow, constant straight push toward the front of the bottle; the sun glows through the perfume like a lantern and slowly sinks behind the skyline.
[8-16 s] Without cutting, the push continues at the same speed with a gentle rise; the sky turns rose then violet; warm light inside the glass deepens to amber.
[16-24 s] Blue hour: city windows switch on one by one and reflect in the marble; tiny city lights sparkle through the perfume.
[24-30 s] Night: the camera slows smoothly and settles exactly on the final composition, the bottle centred front-on against a glittering night city, amber perfume glowing warmly.
AUDIO: none.
No people, no hands, no text overlays, no extra bottles, no second label, no logos besides VESPER.
